title: Orb as ancient relic, compared with Salvator Mundi
summary: Jordan Jose tells of Orb as ancient relic, compared with Salvator Mundi, about ancient–present at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: of the language that was being used as relic like perhaps this isn't something from you know NHI or or something that crashed here like maybe these things have been here a long time

plain: Jordan Jose, who told podcast host Jesse Michels that he was taken into a UFO programme as a child, talks about an orb and the word "relic" that he says was used to describe it. He suggests it may not be something from NHI, short for non-human intelligence, or from a crash, but something that has been here a very long time. He compares it to Salvator Mundi, a painting credited to Leonardo da Vinci. If true, it would mean these objects are ancient rather than recent arrivals.
